summary.key_theme: 儘管分析師普遍維持買入評級並看好長期資本配置策略，但因近期多家投行下調目標價及財報預期不確定性，導致股價短期承壓。

bullish.title: Can CEG's Capital Allocation Strategy Enhance Shareholder Value?
bullish.reason: 文章強調 Constellation Energy 透過高回報成長投資結合股利與庫藏股的策略，能有效強化現金流並提升長期股東價值。

bullish.title: Brokers Suggest Investing in Constellation Energy Corporation (CEG): Read This Before Placing a Bet
bullish.reason: 基於平均經紀商建議 (ABR)，市場仍普遍建議將 CEG 納入投資組合，顯示機構投資人對其基本面仍具信心。

bearish.title: UBS Maintains Buy on Constellation Energy, Lowers Price Target to $380
bearish.reason: UBS 分析師 Ross Fowler 雖維持買入評級，但將目標價從 $388 下調至 $380，反映市場對估值空間的修正。

bearish.title: Barclays Maintains Overweight on Constellation Energy, Lowers Price Target to $324
bearish.reason: Barclays 分析師 Michael Lonegan 下調目標價至 $324，顯示大型投行對該股短期上漲潛力的預期轉趨保守。

bearish.title: TD Cowen Maintains Buy on Constellation Energy, Lowers Price Target to $368
bearish.reason: TD Cowen 分析師 Shelby Tucker 下調目標價至 $368，與其他投行趨勢一致，顯示市場對該公司短期股價動能看法趨於謹慎。

bearish.title: Wells Fargo Maintains Overweight on Constellation Energy, Lowers Price Target to $362
bearish.reason: Wells Fargo 分析師 Shahriar Pourreza 下調目標價至 $362，進一步加深了市場對該股近期目標價下修的共識。

bearish.title: Constellation Energy Corporation (CEG) Stock Drops Despite Market Gains: Important Facts to Note
bearish.reason: 股價在市場整體上漲背景下逆勢下跌 1.59%，顯示短期賣壓與市場情緒轉弱。

neutral.title: Constellation Energy Corporation (CEG) Earnings Expected to Grow: What to Know Ahead of Next Week's Release
neutral.reason: 報導指出公司缺乏財報超預期的關鍵要素，屬於財報前瞻性分析，對股價影響中性，主要提醒投資人關注即將到來的財報數據。
